title: Rift Awakening
pitch: Wake beside strangers beneath an unfamiliar sky. Find shelter in Thornwall, defend the people who take you in, and follow a growing crisis across the Severed Lands to the city of Nexus. Explore six substantial chapters of dangerous places, local stories and purposeful combat, building a life before deciding whether to stay or seek a way home.

title: Last Cart Through
pitch: A broken Guild wagon blocks a forest crossing. Keep its driver safe while hungry Rifthounds close in.

title: The Quarry Turns
pitch: A Rift-touched boar has made a supply trail impassable. Choose your ground before the hunt becomes a charge.

title: Hold the Rope
pitch: A surveyor hangs below a Cairnfields crossing. Clear the approach, then keep the rescue line intact.

title: Dead Inventory
pitch: A recovered suit of Warden armour wakes during an Athenaeum stocktake. Get the porters out before the storeroom becomes wreckage.

title: The Sparring Debt
pitch: A Lodge trainee owes the town an exhibition. Stand in for two friendly bouts and give the audience something worth remembering.

title: No One Left Below
pitch: A salvage crew is trapped in a Hollows cellar. Open a way in, then bring them out before the district shifts.

title: The Cartographer’s Wake
pitch: A stolen chart at a Nexus wake points to a sealed survey vault. Track the thieves, brave the old works and recover the mapmaker’s last expedition record.

title: A Light on Breathing Street
pitch: A lost townhouse returns to the Hollows with a lamp burning upstairs. Explore its trapped rooms, confront hostile Rift echoes and get a family keepsake out before the street shifts.

title: The Honest Thief
pitch: Recover stolen wages from a guarded Thornwall counting-house. Scout the rooms, beat its locks and traps, and get the money and a witness through a dangerous exit.

title: The Bell Below
pitch: A scavengers’ warning bell has vanished into the tunnels beneath the Hollows. Descend through a flooded Warden workhouse, fight its hungry inhabitants and haul the bell back to daylight.

title: The Long Way Round
pitch: Track a missing caravan into the Verdant Margin, break it out of a raider-held wayhouse and escort the survivors through a forest that has swallowed the road.

title: A Debt in Iron
pitch: As Lodge trainee Tavin Bell, retrieve a pledged Warden relic from a dangerous salvage vault, then defend the crew carrying it out while deciding how to face your mentor’s debt.

title: The Scavengers’ Accord
pitch: Two crews need the same route into a newly returned Hollows storehouse. Scout a monster-held district, open its dangerous vault and bring the salvage out before their rivalry turns violent.

title: The Company of the Lost
pitch: Build a salvage company through three dangerous Hollows jobs: a beast-haunted storehouse, a flooded records depot and a contested Warden vault. Your crew’s future depends on what you bring back together.

title: The Map of Tomorrow
pitch: Survey a broken route across the Cairnfields. Climb ruined marker stations, survive Riftbeasts and reclaim a guarded causeway so the next caravan has a road worth trusting.
